build_vitb16_backbone: build a pretrained ViT-B/16 backbone with hooks at layers 2, 5, 8, 11 using _make_pretrained_vitb16_384
build_vitl16_backbone: build a pretrained ViT-L/16 backbone with 1024 features using _make_pretrained_vitl16_384
build_deit_backbone: build a pretrained DeiT-B/16 backbone for distillation using _make_pretrained_deitb16_384
build_vit_rn50_backbone: build a ViT-B/16 with ResNet50 hybrid backbone using _make_pretrained_vitb_rn50_384
run_forward_vit: run forward_vit on a pretrained backbone to extract multi-scale feature maps from input images
